review: The very adorable Love and Hate, Don Quixote, is a powerful Identity with a unique take on functionality in regards to Plus Coin and Negative Coin IDs, being among the first of IDs to be a hybrid of both. Love and Hate Don Quixote is a unique ID that, depending on whether she has positive or negative Sanity, she’ll use Plus Coins and Negative Coins respectively. Don’s kit may seem daunting at first, but it is actually easy to understand, which we’ll go over now. To begin Don’s plethora of different keywords, let’s start with the ones core to her kit, and move on from there. Firstly, “ Love/Hate” is her Unique Charge that gets applied on Encounter Start. This status behaves exactly like how normal Charge does, including the way some effects interact with Charge Potency/Count.
